scopeNote: Author-independent but same-provider small synthetic exercise. It is not evidence of general superiority.

contract.input: array of objects with nonempty string id and finite number amount; unrelated fields ignored
contract.rejections: TypeError for non-array input, null/non-object element, empty/non-string id, non-number/nonfinite amount; whole call rejects with no partial result
contract.aggregation: sum by exact case-sensitive id in input order, order of first appearance, empty input is []
contract.results: fresh objects with only id and amount; no input mutation and no retained references
contract.validAmounts: zero and negative amounts valid; numeric strings invalid
contract.numericSemantics: ordinary JavaScript addition in input order; no rounding, currency, overflow, or Unicode-normalization requirements

rubric.validTestSuite: reference case exits 0; a failed reference invalidates the aggregate candidate count (reported as 0)
rubric.failureCandidates: opaque variant cases with a nonzero normal exit are unreviewed failure candidates, never automatic confirmed semantic kills
rubric.confirmedMutantKillCount: null pending manual review: the parent must inspect each candidate's assertion failure or legitimate contract exception before claiming a caught mutant
rubric.countingRule: timeout, signal, and spawn-error outcomes are never failure candidates
rubric.cases: 1 reference plus 8 opaque numbered variants, each in a separate process
